gloss: approachable; friendly; easy to feel close to

definitions.gloss: approachable; friendly; easy to feel close to
definitions.explanation: Describes a person, atmosphere, or thing that makes others feel at ease and comfortable. Easy to warm up to or feel familiar with.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はとても{親|した}しみやすい{人|ひと}だ。
examples.english: He is a very approachable person.

examples.japanese: {親|した}しみやすい{雰囲気|ふんいき}の{店|みせ}で{食事|しょくじ}をした。
examples.english: We ate at a restaurant with a friendly atmosphere.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}が{親|した}しみやすいおかげで、{質問|しつもん}しやすい{授業|じゅぎょう}になっている。
examples.english: Because the teacher is approachable, it's a class where it's easy to ask questions.

notes: Compound of {親|した}しみ (familiarity/closeness, the noun form of {親|した}しむ) + やすい (easy to). Common collocations: {親|した}しみやすい{人|ひと} (approachable person), {親|した}しみやすい{雰囲気|ふんいき} (friendly atmosphere), {親|した}しみやすいデザイン (user-friendly design). A very positive description for people in service or leadership roles.
